original.target_description: Single study; angry-to-happy transition, White targets; paired-samples t-test comparing the time anger disappeared on old versus young faces among non-Black University of Toronto introductory psychology students. Target identified by the supplied replication project’s explicitly named focal claim.

n.sample_role: Participants in within-subject paired comparison; target test t(47) supports the full 48-person analytic sample.
n.exclusions: No participant exclusions reported in the paper.
n.location: p. 1282, Method: Participants and design; p. 1283, Transition type 2
n.quote: Participants were 48 non-Black introductory psychology students

replication.target_description: Held and Schütz final SCORE report, project 308; focal angry-to-happy transition, White targets; paired-samples t-test comparing disappearance time of anger on old versus young faces; German adults, online Inquisit Web study.

n.sample_role: Participants in focal within-subject paired-samples t-test.
n.exclusions: 60 recruited; four excluded due to missing data and one due to age. One participant with very low response times retained, as noted on PDF p. 8.
n.quote: The replication thus included 55 participants in the analytic sample

reported_success.quote: Thus, this replication was successful according to the SCORE criteria.

notes: No outcome/study locator or neutral description was supplied. The named replication report explicitly identifies the focal SCORE claim, which was used to select the corresponding original comparison independently of input order. Both sources print d, not the requested metric labels; retained printed d without conversion. Original PDF text extraction encodes minus signs as control characters; minus signs are transcribed here. Replication source is the final report dated December 23, 2020; the supplied reference carries a later OSF date. Original analytic n is supported by the participant description together with df=47 in the target paired test; no n was computed from effect size.
